name: native-asr-runtime-settings-backend
title: Migrate Native ASR runtime and settings backend
description: Consume the completed Native large-v3 model manager and bundled CPU runtime, remove Python/venv from production runtime and settings behavior, and prepare one coherent stable-command backend for T18 cutover.
scope: Migrate Tauri ASR routing, model availability/download commands, runtime dependency reporting/storage, and legacy settings input to the Native CPU MVP contracts while preserving T17/T18 boundaries.
creator: zzx
notes: T17 owns the visible frontend migration. T18 owns Release/default Native enablement and Python package removal.
